title: PRODUCTION AGENT L1
description:
Job description:
  
  
Job Description

**Role Purpose**

The purpose of the role is to provide effective technical support to the process and actively resolve client issues directly or through timely escalation to meet process SLAs

͏

**Do**

* **Support process by managing transactions as per required quality standards**
  + Fielding all incoming help requests from clients via telephone and/or emails in a courteous manner
  + Document all pertinent end user identification information, including name, department, contact information and nature of problem or issue
  + Update own availability in the RAVE system to ensure productivity of the process
  + Record, track, and document all queries received, problem-solving steps taken and total successful and unsuccessful resolutions
  + Follow standard processes and procedures to resolve all client queries
  + Resolve client queries as per the SLA s defined in the contract
  + Access and maintain internal knowledge bases, resources and frequently asked questions to aid in and provide effective problem resolution to clients
  + Identify and learn appropriate product details to facilitate better client interaction and troubleshooting
  + Document and analyze call logs to spot most occurring trends to prevent future problems
  + Maintain and update self-help documents for customers to speed up resolution time
  + Identify red flags and escalate serious client issues to Team leader in cases of untimely resolution
  + Ensure all product information and disclosures are given to clients before and after the call/email requests
  + Avoids legal challenges by complying with service agreements

͏

* **Deliver excellent customer service through effective diagnosis and troubleshooting of client queries**
  + Provide product support and resolution to clients by performing a question diagnosis while guiding users through step-by-step solutions
  + Assist clients with navigating around product menus and facilitate better understanding of product features
  + Troubleshoot all client queries in a user-friendly, courteous and professional manner
  + Maintain logs and records of all customer queries as per the standard procedures and guidelines
  + Accurately process and record all incoming call and email using the designated tracking software
  + Offer alternative solutions to clients (where appropriate) with the objective of retaining customers and clients business
  + Organize ideas and effectively communicate oral messages appropriate to listeners and situations
  + Follow up and make scheduled call backs to customers to record feedback and ensure compliance to contract /SLAs

͏

* **Build capability to ensure operational excellence and maintain superior customer service levels of the existing account/client**
  + Undertake product trainings to stay current with product features, changes and updates
  + Enroll in product specific and any other trainings per client requirements/recommendations
  + Partner with team leaders to brainstorm and identify training themes and learning issues to better serve the client
  + Update job knowledge by participating in self learning opportunities and maintaining personal networks

͏

**Deliver**

**No**
**Performance Parameter**
**Measure**
1ProcessNo. of cases resolved per day, compliance to process and quality standards, meeting process level SLAs, Pulse score, Customer feedback2Self- ManagementProductivity, efficiency, absenteeism, Training Hours, No of technical training completed

Mandatory Skills: Record to Report - DOP
  
.

title: Workday Financials Consulting (Global Delivery Center)
description:
**About The Team**
The Cognizant Workday Practice Global Delivery Center is growing across all skill levels and Workday functional areas —and this is your chance to be part of it!
  
  
Join a dynamic team where you’ll work with exciting clients, expand your Workday skills, and take advantage of engagement opportunities that keep you connected and inspired. If you’re ready to grow your career in a collaborative, innovative environment, we’d love to have you on board.
  
  
**About The Role**
Cognizant’s Workday Practice is looking for talent across all levels specializing in Workday Financials. The Workday Financials Consultant plays a key role in managing, configuring, and optimizing the Workday Financial Management system. This role involves close collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration of financial processes, data-driven insights, and enhanced reporting capabilities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Configure and maintain Workday Financial Management modules including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and Asset Management.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather business requirements and deliver tailored financial solutions.
* Ensure seamless integration of Workday with other enterprise systems and financial tools.
* Develop and deploy financial reports, dashboards, and analytics to support decision-making.
* Provide training and support to finance teams on Workday functionalities and best practices.
* Monitor system performance and implement enhancements or fixes as needed.
* Stay updated with Workday releases and recommend relevant upgrades or features.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or related field.
* 3–7+ years of experience in Workday Financials or ERP systems.
* Strong understanding of financial processes such as Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Record-to-Report (R2R), and Order-to-Cash (O2C).
* Experience with Workday modules like Financial Accounting, Reporting, Budgeting, and Integration.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Must be flexible to work in-office 3 days per week

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Workday Financials certification
* Experience in global finance operations or multi-entity environments.
* Familiarity with compliance and audit requirements in financial systems.

**Why Choose Cognizant**

* Entrepreneurial environment that welcomes your ideas
* Opportunity to do great work
* Outreach programs that support communities and tap into your volunteer spirit
* Learning opportunities to help current needs and advancement
* Global operations, with opportunities in North America, Europe and Asia Pacific
* An abundance of Affinity groups to meet your needs

**Cognizant Core Values**

* Work as One: We think beyond roles, relying on each other’s strengths to win as a team.
* Raise the Bar: We always aim for excellence in how we work and what we deliver.
* Dare to Innovate: We push boundaries and take chances to reimagine what’s possible.
* Do the Right Thing: We all lead with integrity and always make the ethical choice.
* Own It: We own the outcomes for our company, colleagues, and community.

title: Application Engineer

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.

We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis

* Maintain an educational program to continually develop personal skills

* Foster teamwork and lead by example
* Training and mentoring of project resources
* Participating in the organization-wide people initiatives

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of Identity Access Management solutions
* Hands-on experience on Azure Active Directory end-to-end implementation involving designing, implementation and customization
* Completed at least 0-2 implementations
* Understanding and experience in different technology of Azure Active Directory, B2E, B2B and B2C
* Implementation experience in ADFS, Azure AD Connect, Azure AD Application Proxy, Conditional Access Policy, LDAP, Active Directory, Application Integrations for SSO and multi-factor authentication
* Working experience in application integration with header-based, SAML2.0, OIDC, OAuth2.0, WS-Fed protocols
* Experienced in managing external identities and consumers in Azure AD B2B and B2C tenants
* Onboarding and offboarding applications on AAD B2B and B2C platforms
* Implementing custom policy using Identity Experience Framework for AAD B2C
* Experience in social login and 3rd party identity provider integration with AAD B2C
* Should have experience in assisting application team to use Microsoft libraries like MSAL
* Experience in integrating mobile application with AAD B2C
* Experience in integrating Azure AD with API management solution
* Should have knowledge on different component of Azure being used for Azure AD solution such as tenant creation, subscription, resource group.
* Should have knowledge in Identity management and Privileged Identity Management concepts
* Experienced in renew, update and troubleshoot certificate related issues
* Should have knowledge of different integration and architecture in customer’s IAM environment such as WAF, Load Balancer, network components
* Understanding of latest technology such as Zero trust framework, Fine-grained authorization, Password less authentication, CIAM
* Experience and exposure of using/exposing REST APIs including Azure AD graph APIs.
* Hands-on knowledge of any programming language Java or Python with good understanding of PowerShell.
* Should be familiar with application servers such as Tomcat and IIS.
* Ability to develop documentation such as business requirement document, high and low level design document, training and user procedures document.
* Deployment of web application & basic troubleshooting of web application issues.
* Should be flexible to work on new technologies in IAM domain.
* Should have had direct client experience, including working with client teams in an on-site or offshore mode.
* Need to liaise with Business stakeholders and seek requirement clarification. Should be able to map business requirements to technical specifications.
* Use case design, Solution Requirements Specification and mapping business requirements to technical requirements (Traceability Matrix).
* Involvement in a successful pursuit of a potential client by being part of the RFP response team.
* Architecture Design for overall IAM solution in customer environment (optimising the resources made available – servers and load sharing etc.).

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* B. Tech./ B.E. with sound technical skills
* Strong command on verbal and written English language.
* Relevant experience in Azure Active Directory.
* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* 2-3 Years’ Work Experience

**Certification:**

* Desirable to have certifications in security domain, such as CISSP and CISA or any IAM product specific certifications
* Desirable to have certifications in Azure Security Domain

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.

In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**

title: Senior Technical Operations Engineer
description:

Senior Technical Operations Engineer
  
  
Fill out the form to apply. Please note due to the large number of applicants we receive we are not able to respond to everyone. You will be contacted if we think you would be a good fit at Diagnal.
  
  
At DIAGNAL, we are a leading technology company specializing in providing innovative solutions for the digital entertainment industry. Our cutting-edge products and services enable millions of users to access high-quality video streaming applications across various devices and screen sizes. As a company, we value collaboration, impact, and the growth of talented individuals. We foster a work environment that emphasizes fair compensation, work-life balance, flexibility, and appreciation for our employees’ contributions. With a focus on learning and development programs, impactful products, and a culture of freedom and autonomy, we strive to create an environment where our team members feel valued and empowered.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Fair compensation: We believe in providing competitive salaries that reflect the value and expertise of our team members.
* Paid Leave: We understand the importance of work-life balance and offer generous paid leave to support our employees’ well-being and personal commitments.
* Work-life balance: We prioritize creating a healthy work-life balance for our employees, recognizing the importance of maintaining personal and professional harmony.
* Flexible Working: We offer flexible working arrangements to accommodate individual preferences and needs, enabling our employees to optimize their productivity and achieve a better work-life integration.
* Activities & events: We organize various activities and events to foster team bonding, creativity, and a positive work culture. These events provide opportunities for relaxation, celebration, and building connections within the DIAGNAL community.

You’ll have the chance to collaborate with cross-functional teams, including designers, project managers, QA engineers, operations engineers, third-party systems providers, and customers, to deliver exceptional products.

* Freedom: We trust our employees and believe in providing them with the freedom to make decisions and execute their work without excessive micromanagement. We value autonomy and encourage independent thinking.
* Feel valued: We genuinely value the contributions and efforts of our team members. We strive to create an inclusive and supportive environment where everyone feels valued, recognized, and appreciated.

**Role**

* Become the first point of contact for customers, providing technical support, responding to technical queries / requirements.
* Troubleshooting application alerts from monitoring tools and performing RCAs
* Liaising with 3rd parties, clients & Diagnal partners
* Demonstrate strong written and oral communication skills; proven ability to work with end users to understand and transform requirements to solutions
* Work on a prioritized task list across multiple clients and complete them in reasonable time.
* Provide hotfixes, alternate workflows and/or additional support on Diagnal products & services to our customers ensuring zero BAU impact.
* Participate in capacity planning, system performance monitoring, resource utilization trends and incident and change management.
* Show initiative and drive in helping build better experience for our customers.
* Collaborate and consult with technical peers, colleagues, and mid to more experienced level managers to resolve systems support issues and achieve customer goals.
* Maintain necessary presentation and documentation for technical artifacts
* Be available at different time zones depending on the project

**Experience Required**

* 5+ years of Experience
* Excellent command over English language
* 2-4 years of experience troubleshooting technical problems in software products.
* 1-2 years of experience in any one scripting language (Nodejs/Python/Bash)
* Project or real-world experience working on Cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases like MySQL/Dynamodb/Elasticsearch
* Familiar with working on a project and ticket management platform, preferably Jira
* Flexible team player with a mindset to work with developers and solution architects.
* Ability to explain issues with clarity and execute resolutions in a time-bound fashion.
* Proven experience in a similar role that includes handling clients & internal teams
* Ability to solve problems with in an innovative, creative and structured manner

title: Kinaxis Lead Analyst
description:
Visteon is advancing mobility through innovative technology solutions that enable a software-defined future. Our state-of-the-art product portfolio merges digital cockpit innovations, advanced displays, AI-enhanced software solutions, and integrated EV architecture solutions. With expertise spanning passenger vehicles, commercial transportation, and two-wheelers, Visteon partners with global automakers to create safer, cleaner, and more connected journeys. Headquartered in Van Buren Township, Michigan, Visteon operates in 17 countries, employing a global network of innovation centers and manufacturing facilities. In 2024, we recorded annual sales of approximately $3.87 billion and secured $6.1 billion in new business.
  
  
Supports the growth and operations of the Kinaxis RapidResponse/Maestro platform within Global IT. Works alongside the Senior Kinaxis Consultant covering system configuration, integration support, testing, and day-to-day operations. Designed for a motivated professional with solid implementation experience ready to take on broader responsibilities
  
  

* Support end-to-end Kinaxis implementations — requirements, configuration, testing, and go-live.
* Build and maintain workbooks, dashboards, alerts, and data views.
* Assist in developing and maintaining data integration pipelines between Kinaxis and external systems (ERP, EDW).
* Monitor data loads and integration jobs; investigate and resolve data quality issues.
* Provide second-line technical support for Kinaxis issues raised by business users.
* Execute testing (unit, integration, UAT); document results and resolve defects.
* 5+ years hands-on Kinaxis Maestro; at least one full end-to-end implementation.
* BS/MS/PhD in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations Research, Computer Science, Statistics or a related field.
* Practical experience building workbooks, dashboards, alerts, or data views.
* Working knowledge of data integration concepts and Kinaxis data feeds.
* Familiarity with SQL for troubleshooting and validation.
* Understanding of core supply chain planning concepts (demand, supply, inventory).
* Familiarity with ITIL concepts or service management practices (incident, change, problem).
* Kinaxis certification a plus; ERP exposure (SAP, QAD, IFS) and ETL experience welcome.

title: Microsoft D365 Supply Chain Super User
description:
**Are you an experienced Supply Chain professional with strong Microsoft D365 expertise?**
Palsgaard is looking for a Microsoft D365 Supply Chain Super User to join our Global Supply Chain organisation and play a key role in our global Microsoft D365 rollout and continuous development journey.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to become part of a global transformation programme where you will combine hands-on Supply Chain knowledge with deep ERP understanding. The role is based in Mumbai, India and reports directly to the Supply Chain Manager India.
  
  
You will act as a key link between business, operations, IT and end users, helping ensure that our global D365 template is successfully implemented, adopted and continuously improved across our international organisation.
  
  
**Your role**
As D365 Super User, you will become a central member of our Global Supply Chain organisation and support both ongoing project activities and future operational support.
  
  
You will be responsible for driving system adoption, supporting users, participating in testing and configuration activities, and ensuring that global standards and processes are consistently applied across the business.
  
  
**The role covers the following Supply Chain areas:**

* Sales & Operations Planning
* Sourcing & Procurement
* Warehouse & Logistics
* Shipping & Transportation

**Key Responsibilities**
**Support our global D365 rollout**

* Participate actively in global D365 implementation and rollout activities
* Support local and global teams during analysis, design, testing, training and go live phases
* Ensure that business requirements are translated into scalable and standardised solutions
* Work closely with Process Owners, Business Process Owners, IT and external implementation partners

**Act as guardian of our Global D365 Template**

* Support and promote standardised global processes
* Help ensure compliance with the approved Global D365 Template
* Challenge local deviations where appropriate
* Contribute to maintaining an evergreen ERP platform with minimal customisation

**Configuration, testing and training**

* Support configuration and parameter setup within D365
* Participate in user acceptance testing and regression testing
* Create and maintain training materials
* Deliver training sessions for users and local Super Users
* Support onboarding of new users

**User support and knowledge sharing**

* Provide first-level support for Supply Chain related D365 topics
* Act as the bridge between operational users and technical teams
* Support issue resolution and continuous improvements
* Share best practices and help develop user capabilities across the organisation

**Future regional support role**
As our D365 platform becomes established across the organisation, this role is expected to evolve into a key support function for our operations in India and Asia.
  
  
You will become one of the primary points of contact for first-line functional support, user guidance and continuous improvement activities across the region.

Platform Operations: Support containerized application lifecycles using Kubernetes architect and manage robust CI/CD pipelines and drive proactive monitoring and rapid troubleshooting of cluster-wide issues.

* Apply Security Measures: Apply and enforce security measures to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with organizational policies and industry regulations.
* Optimize Cloud Costs: Optimize cloud costs by right-sizing resources, developing cost-effective solutions, and monitoring usage patterns.

Master's Degree

* Cloud Migration Project Experience: Experience with cloud migration projects, including implementation and execution, with a focus on effective planning and delivery.

* DevOps Practices Knowledge: Exposure to DevOps practices, such as continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD), with an understanding of their application in cloud infrastructure management.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Cloud Cost Optimization Techniques: Exposure to methods for optimizing cloud costs, including right-sizing resources, developing cost-effective solutions, and monitoring usage patterns to minimize expenses.

* Multi-Cloud Environment Expertise: Exposure to managing and implementing infrastructure solutions across multiple cloud environments, including Oracle Cloud, Nutanix Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, and others.

title: IT & Systems Administrator
description:
**Company Description** 




  





 Shree Rakhi is India’s largest manufacturer of rakhis, dedicated year\-round to supporting the special festival of Raksha Bandhan. With over 70 years of experience, the company has been closely associated with this cultural tradition and its evolving designs and craftsmanship. Shree Rakhi is recognized as India’s only branded rakhi manufacturer with a distribution network that reaches villages, towns, and cities across the country. The organization values reliability, quality, and timely delivery to ensure its products are available wherever customers celebrate Raksha Bandhan.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  






 We are looking for an
 
**IT \& Systems** 


**Administrator** 

 who can manage our complete technology infrastructure, hardware environment, cloud hosting, and critical business applications. This role goes beyond routine IT support; it involves taking complete ownership of the company's technical operations, ensuring seamless reliability across our local networks, Wi\-Fi, and cloud platforms (AWS), and guaranteeing maximum uptime for our ERP and Tally servers. Because our operations are dynamic and spread out, this role requires a hands\-on approach and the readiness to work across our Factory, Warehouse, and Head Office (HO) to ensure uninterrupted business continuity as the organisation grows.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Manage all internal hardware systems, including the provisioning, configuration, and maintenance of PCs, laptops, and VoIP phone systems.
* Maintain an accurate and up\-to\-date hardware and software list, ensuring proper asset management, licensing compliance, and lifecycle tracking.
* Take full ownership of network administration, managing the local area network (LAN), Wi\-Fi infrastructure, routers, switches, and enterprise firewalls to ensure maximum security and seamless connectivity.
* Administer the company's G Suite (Google Workspace) environment, including user account creation, access management, and security settings.
* Formulate, implement, and enforce standard IT policies, best practices, and internal security controls across the organization.
* Deal directly with IT vendors, service providers, and ISPs for procurement, contract negotiation, and resolving third\-party service issues.
* Manage, update, and troubleshoot all operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) across the organization.
* Oversee the hosting, deployment, and optimization of the company website and central ERP system on AWS (or similar cloud infrastructure).
* Manage and maintain on\-premise or cloud\-based Tally servers to ensure the finance and accounting operations run smoothly without data bottlenecks.
* Proactively monitor and manage the uptime, health, and performance of the ERP system to guarantee high availability for daily operations.
* Manage endpoint security, VPNs, user access, and credentials to protect corporate data and prevent unauthorized access.
* Design, implement, and maintain regular data backups and disaster recovery protocols for both on\-premise hardware and cloud environments.
* Work closely with internal teams across all locations to resolve technical support queries, onboarding issues, and system access bottlenecks promptly.



  





**What We Value** 





 We value people who are self\-motivated, energetic, analytical, humble, patient, and eager to learn. You should be comfortable taking initiative, stepping into unfamiliar areas, and figuring things out when there is no ready\-made solution. We look for someone who takes ownership, stays committed to getting the work done, and is willing to go the extra mile while continuously learning and growing with the role.
 




  





**What We’re Looking For** 




  




* 4–6 years of hands\-on experience in IT infrastructure, systems administration, cloud management, or a related field.
* Flexibility and readiness to work on\-site across our Factory, Warehouse, and Head Office (HO) environments as required.
* Expert\-level practical knowledge of managing cloud hosting environments, specifically AWS (EC2, RDS, etc.) or equivalent platforms.
* Strong practical knowledge of network configuration, Wi\-Fi management, LAN setups, and enterprise firewall administration.
* Experience in ERP technical administration, Tally server maintenance, and proactive uptime management.
* Proven experience in G Suite administration, hardware/software inventory management, and IT policy formulation.
* Strong negotiation and communication skills with a track record of effectively dealing with IT vendors and service providers.
* Practical experience managing mixed\-OS environments (Windows/macOS/Linux) and daily IT hardware troubleshooting.

title: IT Executive
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
 



 IT Executive – Hardware, Networking \& IT Support
 



**Department:** 
 Information Technology
 



**Location:** 
 Barasat / Madhyamgram, Kolkata
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Experience:** 
 1–4 Years
 



  





 About the Role
 



 We are looking for a technically skilled and responsible
 **IT Executive** 
 to manage day\-to\-day IT infrastructure, hardware, networking, system support, and troubleshooting across the organization's campuses and offices.
 



 The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the smooth functioning of computers, networking infrastructure, internet connectivity, CCTV, biometric systems, printers, servers, and other IT\-enabled systems.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Hardware \& System Support
 


* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, projectors, and other IT equipment.
* Diagnose and resolve hardware and software issues within defined timelines.
* Perform regular preventive maintenance of IT assets.
* Maintain proper records of IT equipment, repairs, replacements, and service history.
* Coordinate with vendors for hardware repair, replacement, warranty, and AMC\-related matters.



 2\. Network \& Internet Management
 


* Monitor and maintain LAN, WAN, Wi\-Fi, routers, switches, access points, and other networking equipment.
* Troubleshoot network connectivity, internet, and Wi\-Fi\-related issues.
* Coordinate with Internet Service Providers and networking vendors for service\-related problems.
* Configure and maintain routers, switches, and access points as required.
* Monitor network performance and identify recurring connectivity issues.
* Ensure proper network access and connectivity across classrooms, offices, laboratories, and other facilities.



 3\. IT Infrastructure \& Security
 


* Maintain IT infrastructure across different campuses and administrative offices.
* Ensure basic IT security practices, including password management, access control, antivirus, system updates, and backup procedures.
* Monitor and maintain CCTV, biometric attendance, access\-control systems, and other technology\-enabled security systems.
* Assist in identifying and resolving unauthorized device or network access issues.



 4\. Software \& Application Support
 


* Install and configure operating systems, applications, drivers, and required software.
* Provide technical support to employees, faculty members, and administrative staff.
* Troubleshoot issues related to official email, online applications, cloud\-based platforms, and other institutional software.
* Assist users with basic IT\-related queries and provide timely resolution.



 5\. IT Asset Management
 


* Maintain an updated
 **IT Asset Register** 
 covering computers, laptops, printers, networking equipment, CCTV equipment, biometric devices, and other IT assets.
* Track asset allocation, movement, repair, replacement, and disposal.
* Conduct periodic physical verification of IT assets.
* Report damaged, missing, obsolete, or non\-functional equipment to the management.



 6\. Maintenance \& Vendor Coordination
 


* Coordinate with AMC/service providers for timely maintenance and repair of IT infrastructure.
* Maintain records of service calls, complaints, downtime, and resolution status.
* Follow up with vendors until issues are completely resolved.
* Verify service completion before closing maintenance requests.



 7\. Backup \& Data Management
 


* Assist in maintaining regular backups of important institutional data.
* Monitor backup status and report any failure or data\-access issue immediately.
* Follow organizational guidelines regarding data security and confidentiality.



 8\. MIS \& Reporting
 


* Prepare regular IT status reports for management.
* Maintain records of complaints, resolutions, downtime, maintenance, and pending issues.
* Provide daily/weekly reports as required by the reporting authority.
* Maintain proper documentation of all IT\-related activities.



 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 


* Timely resolution of IT support tickets and technical complaints.
* Network and internet uptime.
* Timely preventive maintenance of IT infrastructure.
* Accuracy and regular updating of IT asset registers.
* Timely coordination and follow\-up with service providers.
* Reduction in recurring technical issues and downtime.
* Proper maintenance of IT documentation and reports.
* User satisfaction with IT support services.



 Required Qualifications
 


* Bachelor's/Diploma degree in
 **Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Applications, Electronics, or a related field** 
 .
* Relevant IT certifications will be an added advantage.



 Required Skills
 


* Strong knowledge of computer hardware and troubleshooting.
* Good understanding of LAN, WAN, TCP/IP, Wi\-Fi, routers, and switches.
* Knowledge of Windows operating systems and common business applications.
* Basic understanding of IT security and data backup.
* Knowledge of CCTV and biometric systems will be an advantage.
* Good vendor coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Strong documentation and reporting skills.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and handle multiple technical issues simultaneously.



 Preferred Experience
 


* **1–4 years of experience** 
 in IT support, hardware, networking, or infrastructure management.
* Experience in an
 **educational institution, corporate office, hospital, or multi\-location organization** 
 will be preferred.



 Working Requirements
 


* Willingness to travel between institutional campuses/offices whenever required.
* Ability to respond to urgent technical issues when required.
* Ability to work under deadlines and maintain proper documentation.
* Strong sense of responsibility, confidentiality, and service orientation.
* Salary:Negotiable as per experience

title: Senior Specialist - IT Digital Workplace
description:
**Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd \| Business Area: Information Services (IT)**
 Senior Specialist \- IT Digital Workplace
   

  

**Kolkata, West Bengal, India \| Workplace Type: On\-Site \| Job Type: Regular / Permanent / Unlimited / FTE \| Reference Code: req32429**
 It's about Being What's next. What's in it for you?
   

  

 The Senior Specialist in this position will ensure workplace services within the M365 and Global Workplace Services organization meet business needs. Will also design, build, optimize, and maintain secure, efficient Windows client services using defined standards and policies in a cost\-effective manner. And provide expert support for the SCCM platform, including Windows client management, compliance, deployment/provisioning, patching, and software distribution. Lastly, act as a key contributor to global initiatives, primarily focused on Intune technologies.
   

  

 At Linde, employees can enjoy a range of benefits that make the workplace comfortable and enjoyable. These include loyalty offers, annual leave, an on\-site eatery, employee resource groups, and teams that provide support and foster a sense of community. These benefits demonstrate Linde's commitment to creating a positive work experience for its employees.
   

  

 Team
   

  

 Making an impact. What will you do?
   

  

* You will be managing SCCM/MECM infrastructure, OSD, task sequences, collections, feature updates, compliance, and L3 support
* Designing and maintaining Windows 10/11 client standards, images, lifecycle management, and Evergreen strategy
* You will also lead hardware, driver, firmware, and Windows upgrade management
* Developing and automating solutions using PowerShell
* Also, create compliance reports, deployment documentation, and operational runbooks
* Lastly, support global projects, major incidents, and on\-call rotations


 Winning in your role. Do you have what it takes?
   

  

* A degree or equivalent from a reputed institute, Formal training and/ or certification in Intune / Modern Desktop, SCCM \& Microsoft Technologies
* Five to eight (5\-8\) years of relevant IT experience working with reputed companies. Good technical knowledge in the Intune /MECM Infrastructure
* Experience working in a global or distributed team (preferred, not mandatory). And strong English communication skills
* You have expertise and technical proficiency in IT Workplace services (preferably Intune) and working experience in medium to large enterprise environments
* And you have strong knowledge in Software Deployment– MSI / EXE packaging, Powershell deployments, Detection methods, Requirement rules
* Device Configuration \- Configuration Profiles, Administrative Templates, Settings Catalog, Custom OMA\-URI Policies
* Azure Virtual Desktop – management of, host pools, app groups, sessions hosts, image management, FSLogix
* Windows Validation \- OS Compatibility Testing, Application Readiness Testing, Driver Validation, Upgrade Validation


 Why you will love working for us!
   

  

 Linde is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2025 sales of $34 billion. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high\-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain, decarbonize and protect our planet. Linde serves a variety of end markets such as chemicals \& energy, food \& beverage, electronics, healthcare, manufacturing, metals and mining. Linde’s industrial gases and technologies are used in countless applications, enabling space exploration and launch technologies, delivering ultra\-high\-purity and specialty gases for semiconductor manufacturing, providing life\-saving medical oxygen and enabling clean hydrogen production and carbon capture to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Linde also delivers state\-of\-the\-art gas processing solutions to support customer growth, efficiency improvements and emissions reductions.
   

  

 Linde Global Support Services Pvt. Ltd. (LGSS) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Linde, based out of Kolkata, India. It is a Global IT Delivery Center that has been successfully delivering IT Enabled Services to the group companies of Linde, across the world for almost two decades, since 2006\. Our goal is to provide and support IT services and solutions that are critical for the operation of the entire group. As part of Linde's core Global IT Team, we cover a wide portfolio of IT services and solutions that ensure the continuous operation of Linde's business across multiple businesses across various geographies, time zones and cultures. The technical teams use their IT skills and experience to maintain and manage the IT applications and infrastructure of the organization.
   

  

 At Linde Global IT Delivery Center, Kolkata we offer exciting career opportunities to grow and work in leading technologies in a truly global work environment.
   

  

 Whatever you seek to accomplish, and wherever you want those accomplishments to take you, a career at Linde provides limitless ways to achieve your potential, while making a positive impact in the world. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
   

  

 For more information about the company and its products and services, please visit linde.com
   

  

 Have we inspired you? Let's talk about it!

**Cyber Managed Service – Identity and access Management – Senior**
 We are seeking an experienced and knowledgeable Senior Consultant for Entra SSO Operations to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in identity and access management, with extensive experience in managing and optimizing Entra SSO solutions. This role will involve leading operational initiatives, providing expert guidance, and ensuring the security and efficiency of our SSO environment.
   

  

**Key Requirements / Responsibilities:**
* Provide expert L2 and L3 support for Entra SSO\-related issues, including troubleshooting complex user access problems, application integration challenges, and system outages.
* Lead the management of user identities and organizational groups within the Entra SSO platform, ensuring accurate and timely provisioning and deprovisioning of access rights.
* Oversee the integration of new applications into the Entra SSO environment, collaborating with application owners and IT teams to ensure seamless Single Sign\-On (SSO) functionality.
* Monitor Entra SSO system performance and logs, proactively identifying and addressing potential issues before they impact users and implementing performance optimization strategies.
* Develop and maintain Entra SSO policy documentation, user guides, and training materials to support end\-users and promote best practices across the organization.
* Experience with App Registration and Enterprise applications
* Conduct regular security reviews and audits of Entra SSO configurations to ensure alignment with industry standards and compliance requirements and recommend improvements as necessary.
* Drive the implementation of Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) policies across the organization to enhance security posture and user experience.
* Collaborate with IT and security teams to refine and enforce access control policies, ensuring the principle of least privilege is maintained and compliance is achieved.
* Manage the resolution of tickets and service requests related to Entra SSO, prioritizing based on impact and urgency, and mentoring junior staff in troubleshooting techniques.
* Stay updated on new Entra SSO features and updates, participating in relevant training and knowledge\-sharing sessions to maintain expertise in the platform and share insights with the team.
* Provide strategic feedback and suggestions to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the Entra SSO service, including identifying automation opportunities and process enhancements.
* Drive the automation and optimization of operational processes to enhance system reliability and reduce manual workload.
* Mentor junior operations analysts and contribute to the development of training materials and best practices


**Preferred Skills:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience); master’s degree is a plus.
* 5\+ years of experience in IT operations or support, with a focus on identity and access management, specifically with Entra SSO or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of security protocols and standards (e.g., SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect) and their application in SSO environments.
* Proven experience in leading operational initiatives and managing complex technical issues.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience in consulting role is preferred, with a track record of delivering high\-quality service to clients.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate, ITIL, or similar


**Education:**

title: Server Administrator
description:
**Company Description** 
 Gozo is a travel technology company transforming how people travel between cities across India. With service coverage in over 6,000 towns and cities, Gozo operates a large network of chauffeured cabs focused on comfort, affordability, and quality. The platform aggregates vetted cab providers nationwide to match customer demand with reliable operators who deliver service with transparency and trust. Gozo’s vision is to be the most trusted travel experience provider in India, creating personalized and memorable trips for both business and leisure travelers. The company emphasizes pre\-screened drivers, commercially licensed vehicles, and strong repeat customer rates driven by consistent service quality.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Server Administrator role based in the Kolkata metropolitan area. The Server Administrator will manage and maintain server and system infrastructure supporting Gozo’s travel technology platform, including installation, configuration, monitoring, and performance optimization. Daily responsibilities include handling system updates and patches, ensuring data security and backups, monitoring system health, and resolving technical issues to minimize downtime. The role involves close collaboration with development and operations teams to support deployments, troubleshoot production incidents, and improve reliability and scalability. The Server Administrator will also document procedures, implement best practices, and provide technical support to internal stakeholders.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong Server Administration skills, including installation, configuration, monitoring, and performance optimization of server environments.
* Solid System Administration experience managing user accounts, permissions, backups, and system security across multiple environments.
* Proficient in Troubleshooting and Technical Support, with the ability to diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and network\-related issues.
* Hands\-on experience with Operating Systems (such as Linux/Unix and Windows Server) and familiarity with scripting or automation tools.

title: TC-CS-IAM-SailPoint-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\-Cyber Security\-IAM\- SailPoint IIQ Staff**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
   

  

 In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next\-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
   

  

 As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* 1\-4 years of experience in designing and deploying IIQ\-based Identity Governance and Administration solutions
* Ability to drive IGA projects including project management, team management, client management.
* Should have experience in implementing at least one complete IAM SDLC engagements projects. This must include activities such as requirements gathering, analysis, design, development, testing, deployment and application support
* Must have experience in SailPoint IIQ \& IDN architecture, design, development, configuration, testing, integration, and deployment.
* Must have experience in source/ Identity profile configuration, transform/rule development, workflow configuration, JML process and certification, Password sync.
* Must have experience in onboarding AD, JDBC and web service applications to IIQ/IDN
* Must have experience in deployment of virtual appliance, understanding different VA architecture, deploy rules in cloud/VA, High availability/DR configuration
* Configuration and deployment of IQService in cloud and on\-prem environments
* Must have hands on experience in configuring quick link, custom work flow, reports, developing service account management modules, integration with other tools like Service Now, CyberArk etc and plugin development
* IIQ Installation, set up and initial configuration/ upgradation to different versions of IIQ, Standard service build set up and configuration
* Professional IT certifications are a plus.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Infra Tech Support Practitioner
description:
**Project Role :** 
 Infra Tech Support Practitioner
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Provide L1–L2 technical support for infrastructure, systems, and applications in production and development environments, both remotely and onsite, following defined operating models and processes. Act as the primary interface with users/clients to accurately diagnose issues and deliver effective resolutions across infrastructure, operating systems, networks, and application platforms, ensuring service stability and quality support.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Elastic Stack (ELK)
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 As an Infra Tech Support Practitioner, a typical day involves delivering first and second level technical assistance for infrastructure, systems, and applications across both production and development settings. This role requires working closely with users and clients to identify and resolve technical issues efficiently, whether remotely or onsite. The practitioner follows established procedures and operating models to maintain service reliability and quality, ensuring smooth operation of various platforms including infrastructure, operating systems, and networks. Collaboration and communication are key throughout the day to support continuous service availability and user satisfaction.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

* Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
* Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
* Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
* Monitor and maintain infrastructure health to prevent potential disruptions.
* Document and escalate complex issues to higher support levels when necessary.
* Assist junior team members by sharing knowledge and providing guidance.
* Continuously update technical knowledge to adapt to evolving infrastructure technologies.


 Professional \& Technical Skills:
   

  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Elastic Stack (ELK).
* Experience with log management and analysis using Elastic Stack components.
* Strong understanding of infrastructure monitoring and troubleshooting techniques.
* Familiarity with operating systems and network fundamentals related to infrastructure support.
* Ability to analyze and resolve issues in production and development environments.
* Good communication skills to interact effectively with users and technical teams.


 Additional Information:
   

  

* The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Elastic Stack (ELK).
* This position is based at our Kolkata office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

 We’re looking for people who are curious, driven, and ready to challenge the status quo, people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and build things that matter.
 



 If you’re ready to push boundaries, solve problems that matter, and help shape the next generation of cybersecurity, we’d love to have you build the future with us.
 



**Job Summary:** 




 We are looking for a highly motivated and customer\-focused Customer Support \& Professional Services Engineer with strong expertise in Firewall, cybersecurity, and network infrastructure. In this role, you will be responsible for deploying, integrating, and supporting Vehere’s AI\-powered network security solutions across enterprise environments. You will work closely with customer SOC teams, network engineers, and internal product teams to ensure successful implementation, optimal performance, and rapid issue resolution.
 



**Key Roles and Responsibilities:** 



* Deliver end\-to\-end deployment and professional services for Vehere firewall solutions, including installation, configuration, integration, and optimization.
* Provide Level 1/Level 2 technical support to enterprise customers, ensuring timely resolution and excellent customer experience.
* Monitor firewall logs, security events, and traffic patterns to identify suspicious activities, security threats, performance bottlenecks, and policy violations.
* Perform firewall health checks, firmware upgrades, patch management, and security hardening activities to ensure optimal device performance and compliance.
* Collaborate with SOC, Network, and Security teams to investigate security alerts, support incident response activities, and strengthen network security posture.
* Troubleshoot complex firewall and network security issues by analyzing traffic flows, packet captures (PCAP), routing configurations, and firewall logs, escalating cases to Engineering when required.
* Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for security incidents, network outages, and firewall\-related service disruptions, providing actionable recommendations and preventive measures.
* Support firewall migration, rule\-base review, policy optimization, and change management activities while minimizing business impact and ensuring compliance with security standards.
* Apply strong knowledge of networking concepts including TCP/IP, Routing, Switching, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, and cybersecurity principles to support secure and resilient network environments.
* Work with leading firewall technologies and security features such as Next\-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS), URL Filtering, Application Control, Anti\-Malware, and Threat Intelligence integrations.
* Adhere to high\-quality work standards.
* Responsible for maintaining Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability of Vehere’s information assets including business critical information.



  





**Skills and Experience:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Electronics, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 5\+ years of experience in Firewall Support, Network Security, Technical Support, or Professional Services.
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise firewall technologies and network security solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting skills involving routing, switching, VPNs, NAT, packet capture analysis, and security event investigation.
* Familiarity with Linux systems and command\-line troubleshooting is desirable.
* Working knowledge of SIEM, SOC operations, and incident response processes is an advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong customer\-facing abilities.
* Relevant certifications such as CCNA, CCNP Security, CEH, NSE, PCNSE, or equivalent are preferred.

**Blue Dart Express Limited**

Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.
   

  

 Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
   

  

 We are proud to be consistently ranked among
 **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work** 
 , combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an
 **Employer of Choice** 
 is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
   

  

 If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety,
 **Blue Dart is where you belong** 
 . Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
   

  

**Position Overview:**
 The Executive / Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – IT is responsible for ensuring the availability, stability and day\-to\-day support of IT infrastructure and end\-user systems across operational and administrative locations within the assigned region. The role coordinates IT support activities, manages vendor service delivery, resolves infrastructure issues and ensures minimal disruption to business operations.
   

  

 Working closely with Operations, Customer Service, Commercial, HR and Corporate IT teams, the role provides first and second\-level support for IT infrastructure, end\-user computing, hardware, software and network\-related issues while ensuring adherence to service levels, IT standards and information security requirements.
   

  

**Job Purpose:**
 To provide reliable, responsive and efficient IT support across the assigned region by ensuring timely resolution of technology issues, effective vendor coordination, high system availability and uninterrupted business operations through proactive infrastructure support and adherence to IT governance standards.
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**
**Regional IT Operations Support**
* Provide day\-to\-day IT support across all operational and administrative locations within the assigned region, ensuring high system availability and minimal business disruption.
* Coordinate resolution of hardware, software, network and system\-related issues impacting business operations.
* Ensure operational locations receive timely IT support in accordance with defined service levels.
* Provide on\-site support for critical IT issues where remote resolution is not feasible.
* Support regional IT readiness for new branch openings, relocations, expansions and operational infrastructure changes.


**Incident \& Service Request Management**
* Manage IT incidents and service requests from logging through resolution, ensuring adherence to defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Prioritise and coordinate resolution of business\-critical incidents impacting operational continuity.
* Perform first\-level troubleshooting and coordinate with specialised support teams for second and third\-level issues.
* Track recurring incidents, identify root causes and recommend preventive actions.
* Maintain accurate incident documentation, escalation records and service request updates.


**End User Computing \& Infrastructure Support**
* Support end\-user devices including desktops, laptops, printers, handheld devices, scanners and other operational IT equipment.
* Coordinate installation, configuration and maintenance of approved hardware, software and peripheral devices.
* Ensure timely provisioning and replacement of IT equipment for employees and operational locations.
* Support connectivity, user access, system availability and peripheral device functionality across the region.
* Coordinate preventive maintenance activities to maximise infrastructure reliability and equipment uptime.


**Vendor Management \& Service Delivery**
* Coordinate and monitor regional IT support vendors to ensure timely and effective service delivery.
* Track vendor performance against agreed SLAs and escalate service gaps where required.
* Validate completion of vendor activities and ensure quality of work performed.
* Coordinate warranty repairs, Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs) and third\-party support activities.
* Build effective working relationships with vendor partners to ensure uninterrupted IT support across the region.


**IT Asset \& Inventory Management**
* Maintain accurate records of regional IT assets including desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, handheld devices and networking equipment.
* Coordinate asset allocation, movement, replacement and disposal in accordance with organisational policies.
* Support periodic IT asset verification and inventory audits.
* Ensure software licensing, asset tagging and documentation remain accurate and up to date.
* Monitor asset lifecycle and recommend timely replacement of ageing or obsolete equipment.


**Business Continuity \& Operational Readiness**
* Support business continuity by ensuring IT systems remain operational across all regional locations.
* Coordinate IT readiness for new operational sites, office relocations and infrastructure expansion projects.
* Participate in disaster recovery activities, system recovery testing and operational contingency planning where applicable.
* Ensure critical operational systems supporting logistics and customer service remain available with minimal downtime.
* Provide IT support during peak business periods and critical operational events to ensure uninterrupted business operations.


**Information Security \& IT Governance**
* Ensure compliance with organisational IT policies, information security standards and regulatory requirements across all regional locations.
* Support implementation of IT security controls, endpoint protection, user access management and system compliance initiatives.
* Coordinate timely installation of software updates, security patches and antivirus definitions in collaboration with Corporate IT and support vendors.
* Report IT security incidents, system vulnerabilities and policy deviations, ensuring timely corrective actions.
* Promote awareness of information security best practices among regional users.


**Cross\-functional Stakeholder Support**
* Partner with Operations, Customer Service, Commercial, Finance, HR and other business functions to understand IT support requirements and ensure timely service delivery.
* Coordinate with Corporate IT teams for system upgrades, application deployments, infrastructure enhancements and enterprise\-wide IT initiatives.
* Provide IT support for new branch openings, relocations, office expansions and operational infrastructure changes.
* Assist business users during rollout of new applications, hardware and technology solutions.
* Maintain effective communication with stakeholders regarding incident status, planned maintenance and system availability.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Identify recurring IT issues and recommend process improvements to enhance service quality and operational efficiency.
* Support implementation of new technologies, automation initiatives and digital solutions that improve business productivity.
* Recommend improvements to IT support processes, knowledge documentation and service delivery standards.
* Contribute to regional IT projects and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Foster a culture of customer service, collaboration, accountability, innovation and continuous learning.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**
**Education** 
 :
   

  

  

* Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Electronics, Computer Engineering or a related discipline is mandatory.
* Relevant technical certifications such as Microsoft, Cisco, ITIL, CompTIA or equivalent will be an added advantage.


**Experience** 
 :
   

  

  

* 3–6 years of experience in IT Infrastructure Support, End User Computing, Desktop Support or Regional IT Operations.
* Experience supporting multi\-location business operations within a regional environment.
* Strong experience in hardware troubleshooting, operating systems, user support and IT infrastructure coordination.
* Experience coordinating with outsourced IT support vendors and monitoring service delivery against agreed SLAs.
* Exposure to IT asset management, incident management, user access administration and IT support processes.
* Experience supporting logistics, transportation, warehousing, manufacturing, retail or other multi\-site organisations will be preferred.


**Skills \& Capabilities:**
**Technical Skills:**
* IT Infrastructure \& End User Support
* Hardware \& Peripheral Device Support
* Windows Operating Systems \& Microsoft Office
* Basic Network Troubleshooting
* IT Incident \& Service Request Management
* IT Asset \& Inventory Management
* Vendor \& SLA Management
* Active Directory \& User Access Management (preferred)
* IT Security \& Endpoint Compliance

* Continuous Improvement Mindset

title: iScala Analyst
description:
iScala ERP Analyst
   

  

 At Johnson Controls, you will join a global organization focused on helping customers improve performance, safety, and efficiency across critical environments. In this role, you will support iScala ERP users and help keep core business processes running smoothly through reliable functional support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 The iScala ERP Analyst will provide day\-to\-day application support across iScala ERP and connected solutions, helping users resolve issues, maintain stable operations, and improve how the system supports business processes. This role is well suited for someone with 4\-6 years of hands\-on experience in ERP support or techno\-functional analysis who enjoys solving problems, working with cross\-functional teams, and supporting end users in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Provide functional support for iScala ERP users and resolve application issues, service requests, and support tickets.
* Support troubleshooting and hyper care activities across iScala ERP and the Edge Apps ecosystem.
* Work with business and technical teams to analyze issues, identify root causes, and coordinate fixes or workarounds.
* Assist with functional deployment across Build, SIT, UAT, and end\-user training activities.
* Support localization, electronic invoicing, advanced functions, and statutory or regulatory compliance needs within the ERP environment.
* Develop and maintain reports, interfaces, and workflow integrations using relevant Epicor and database technologies.
* Document solutions, user guidance, and support outcomes to improve system understanding and future issue resolution.
* Contribute to upgrades, testing, and process improvements that strengthen overall ERP performance.


 How You Will Do It
   

  

* You will take ownership of issues end to end, working with urgency and accuracy to restore service and support business continuity.
* You will stay close to the work by partnering with users, understanding process flows, and removing obstacles before they affect customers or operations.
* You will use structured problem\-solving and root cause analysis to move beyond quick fixes and help prevent repeat issues.
* You will collaborate openly across functional and technical teams, sharing knowledge and contributing to solutions that improve the system for everyone.
* You will look for continuous improvements in support, documentation, testing, and automation so the ERP environment becomes more efficient over time.


**Qualifications**
* 4\-6 years of experience in iScala ERP support, techno\-functional analysis, or a similar ERP application support role.
* Strong hands\-on knowledge of iScala ERP and related business processes.
* Experience supporting functional configuration, troubleshooting, deployment, and user issue resolution.
* Working knowledge of MS SQL Server 2019, SQL Programming, SSRS Report Development, and SSIS Development.
* Experience with database management, complex SQL scripting, and investigation of ERP interfaces.
* Familiarity with Epicor Service Connect or similar integration tools is strongly valued.
* Ability to communicate clearly with users and cross\-functional stakeholders in English.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience supporting iScala localization, electronic invoicing, or compliance\-related ERP functions.
* Prior exposure to hyper care support, system upgrades, Build/SIT/UAT cycles, or end\-user training.
* Experience creating user documentation, support guides, or process notes for business users.


 Why Join Us
   

  

 You will be part of a collaborative environment where your work directly supports business users and operational stability. Johnson Controls offers a competitive salary and benefits package, along with opportunities for professional growth and development.
   

  

 If you are ready to bring your iScala ERP experience to a role where your problem\-solving skills can make a real impact, we would love to hear from you.

**About The Role**
 The Senior Security Vulnerability Remediation Specialist is a targeted Infrastructure Operations role responsible for assessing, remediating, automating, and sustaining security vulnerability fixes across Hyland's internal infrastructure. * Partner with Engineering to design and implement automation and scripting that streamlines remediation using repeatable, scalable solutions that harden the environment and prevent reintroduction of vulnerabilities.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure Support and Engineering teams to identify recurring vulnerability patterns and implement protocols and procedures that prevent issues from resurfacing.
* Monitor vulnerability remediation queues, SLAs, and aging metrics to ensure commitments are met, reporting is current, and operational documentation is continuously improved.
